verdict.rationale: The Azure cloud platform itself shows no evidence of open-source availability. Only peripheral Azure components show any openness: Azurite is explicitly described as an "open-source emulator", and the Azure CLI source is hosted on GitHub, though no license is cited for it. missing for 10: any open-source license for the core Azure platform/services, an explicitly named license (e.g., MIT) for the CLI or other tooling, independent corroboration of source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
